nodes.label: kong/init.lua
nodes.desc: Entry point: builds the global kong table at L65 and exposes nginx phase callbacks Kong.rewrite L1112, Kong.access L1186, Kong.balancer L1270

nodes.label: conf_loader
nodes.desc: Parses kong.conf and declarative config; computes conf.loaded_plugins at L839

nodes.label: global (kong table)
nodes.desc: The global kong namespace; init_pdk at L161 wires the PDK into _G.kong

nodes.label: PDK root
nodes.desc: MAJOR_MODULES list L193: kong.request, kong.response, kong.service, kong.table, kong.log...

nodes.label: kong_defaults
nodes.desc: Default settings: proxy_listen 0.0.0.0:8000 and :8443 ssl L27, admin_listen 127.0.0.1:8001 and :8444 L29, admin_gui_listen :8002 L30

nodes.label: nginx_kong template
nodes.desc: Generated nginx.conf wiring: rewrite/access/header_filter/log by_lua blocks L145-163 call Kong.*, proxy_pass to kong_upstream L216

nodes.label: runloop handler
nodes.desc: Per-request phase table: preread L1100, rewrite L1177, access L1184, header_filter L1510, log L1638; runs the router and the balancer

nodes.label: router
nodes.desc: Router factory: FLAVOR_TO_MODULE L17 picks traditional/expressions; exec L24 and select L29 match a request to a Route

nodes.label: plugins iterator
nodes.desc: Loads configured plugin rows L523 and yields per-phase plugin handlers (get_collecting_iterator L414)

nodes.label: balancer
nodes.desc: execute L290 picks an upstream target for the request; healthchecks and retries live alongside

nodes.label: DB / DAO
nodes.desc: Loads entity schemas (services, routes, consumers...), validates them and builds DAOs L115; strategies: postgres or off

nodes.label: Admin API
nodes.desc: Admin API app on :8001; auto-generates CRUD endpoints from every DAO schema L91-95
